answer: Proof-of-stake mechanisms utilize staked capital as a zephyr of economic weight to anchor identity, ensuring agents act as a lantern illuminating the true network state. By imposing a high capital cost to mint identity, the protocol forces an attacker to cross the economic ridge of stake-weighted influence. This renders the creation of numerous fake nodes prohibitively expensive, as Sybil attempts require locking significant assets that are perpetually exposed to slashing penalties.
